hooks.command: R="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.product/tutti-frutti"; if git -C "$R" pull --ff-only --quiet 2>/dev/null; then echo "Product code synced with GitHub."; else echo "Product code: git pull failed (offline or local changes), using the local copy."; fi; git -C "$R" log -1 --format="Product code (.product/tutti-frutti) is at commit %h: %s (%cr)"
